title: Feature: Suspend for X minutes / until reactivated
symptom: Users who only want overnight CGM with Libre and blueReader are getting alarms from xDrip all day long, and there is no way to disable xDrip's functionality for a given period or until reactivation.
fix: The Sept 22nd nightly includes a new data source option of `Disable Collection` which switches the collector off. You should be able to change data source to this which will shut down the collector.
evidence_quote: The Sept 22nd nightly includes a new data source option of `Disable Collection` which switches the collector off. Please let me know if this helps. You should be able to change data source to this which will shut down the collector.
